summary: Dependency-confusion beacon posts host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and on require
details: The package publishes under the @grabcad scope at version 99.0.1 but ships no real implementation: index.js exports a Proxy no-op shim and the package description is 'Compatibility shim.' The actual payload is beacon.cjs, which is wired as a postinstall script and is also invoked from the main entry on require. It constructs a JSON payload containing the installer's hostname (os.hostname()), install path (__dirname), current working directory (process.cwd()), and Node.js version (process.version), and POSTs it over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The combination of a scoped stub package, an implausibly high version number (99.0.1) designed to win resolution against an internal @grabcad package, and unconditional transmission of host identifiers to a non-first-party bare-IP destination at both install time and require time is a dependency-confusion probe that exfiltrates installer-side identifiers to attacker-controlled infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
